question: Who among the following was the first para-athlete to receive the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Jhajharia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia **__was the first para-athlete to receive the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna.
 
• Devendra Jhajharia is a para-athlete and javelin thrower.
 __
 
• He is the first in India to win two gold medals at Para Olympics.
 
• He won gold in 2004 and the 2016 Para Olympics.
 
• He is also the only Para Athlete to be awarded Padma Shri.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award has been renamed after hockey legend, Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• The prestigious award carries prize money of Rs 25 lakh.
 
• It also comprises a medallion, a certificate.
 
• The Khel Ratna award was instituted in 1991-1992 and the first recipient was Chess legend, Viswanathan Anand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Varun Singh Bhati **is a para high jumper from India. He has won several medals in international events including bronze at the 2016 Summer Paralympic Games and the 2017 World Para Athletics Championships.
 
• **Naresh Kumar Sharma **is a five-time Paralympian shooter.
 
• **Mariyappan Thangavelu **is an Indian Paralympic high jumper. He represented India in the 2016 Summer Paralympics games
